name: QualGent
long_description:
QualGent is an AI Mobile App Quality Assurance Tester that mimics a real human, helping teams catch bugs and ship faster - without hiring more QA testers. One customer reached #3 in the Education category on the App Store by improving app quality with QualGent.

Mobile bugs hurt: crashes kill ratings, broken checkouts drive churn. QualGent helps teams scale QA effortlessly and avoid Sonos-level disasters.

The idea for QualGent was born from the founders’ experience leading engineering teams at Google across Android XR, Stadia, Quick Share, and foldable devices where shipping to billions of users meant constantly facing the painful trade-off between moving fast and maintaining quality. With prior research experience at Nvidia, Maryland, and Berkeley, the team saw a clear opportunity: use AI to scale QA.

QualGent’s vision is to close the loop on software creation. As AI enables engineers to code 100x faster, QualGent eliminates the next bottleneck—software verification—unlocking truly scalable, end-to-end software development.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
CEO at QualGent, ex-Googler in AI, XR and Android

Shivam is a customer-obsessed engineer who spent 5 years at Google building AI products, visual interfaces, and frameworks. He led Android XR’s 3D system UI, shipping it in one-fifth the time it took Apple to launch VisionOS, and built the team’s most-used tool - a C++ simulator that 10x-ed developer velocity. Recognized as the fastest executor on the team, he left to fix the biggest bottleneck he faced firsthand: mobile QA.

launches.title: QualGent V3: A fully capable, self-healing agentic mobile QA platform
launches.tagline: The wait is over. Unleash your AI mobile QA workforce now.
launches.body:
We just dropped the biggest update in our history, and we’re opening the gates. We didn’t just build a smarter brain; we built the entire nervous system. QualGent V3 is now a fully capable, self-healing agentic mobile QA platform that integrates directly into your app development and release lifecycle.\
\
https://youtu.be/A6DUE6C20Mw?si=GEW13qMS49jN_s8G

**The V3 upgrades:**

🚀 **Instant Self-Serve:** No waitlists. Sign up, upload your app, write tests in plain English and run 1000s of parallel tests _today_. 

⚡ **Parallel Cloud Scale:** Run your entire regression suite on thousands of real devices and emulators concurrently. What used to take your QA team 3 days now takes your AI workforce 30 minutes.

**🔗 Deep Workflow Integration**

* Native integrations for **GitHub CI/CD**, **Slack**, and **Linear**. Bugs go straight to your issue tracker; results go straight to your team.
* **Developer APIs:** Complete control. Customize your automation workflow for uploads, triggers, and reporting via our new API.

📱 **Total Coverage**

* **Landscape & Tablets:** We’ve unlocked landscape testing across tablets and mobile browsers. Any device. Any orientation.
* **Multi-Account Magic:** New **Credential Management** handles login rotations seamlessly for multi-user testing.

🔓 **Enterprise Control**

* **Smart Dashboard:** Track every test by **app build**. See exactly which commit caused the regression.
* **Bulk Runs:** Use **Category Tagging** to trigger specific suites (e.g., "Smoke," "Checkout," "Payments") instantly.

🧠 **Self-Learning & Self-Generating**

* **Agentic memory:** Our AI agents don't just execute; they now learn. With memory layers, v3 remembers past interactions, learning from every bug and successful flow to get smarter with every run.
* **AI Test Creation Agent**: Don't just automate execution; automate creation. Our agent writes the test cases for you based on the context it learns about your app.

With QualGent V3, we’ve moved beyond testing automation, this is testing orchestration. Legacy QA automation is technical debt. QualGent V3 is technical leverage. Stop testing manually and maintaining brittle test scripts. Start commanding an autonomous AI QA workforce.

**Deploy your AI workforce now:** https://qualgent.link/qualgent-ai

launches.title: QualGent: AI Quality Assurance agent for mobile software testing
launches.tagline: Test Mobile Apps with Natural Language on Real Devices in the Cloud
launches.body:
Today, we’re launching QualGent, an AI Quality Assurance agent for mobile that helps companies catch more bugs and ship much faster without hiring more human QA testers. One customer hit **#3 in the App Store’s Education category** by improving their app quality and release process with QualGent.

https://youtu.be/k1eSm6QvO9c

**🐛 The Problem: Mobile QA is a Bottleneck**

Shipping a great mobile app is hard. Even top teams struggle with flaky end-to-end tests, missed edge cases, and regressions that slip past CI.

Script-based automation tools like Playwright, Selenium, Appium or Espresso break often. Visual diff tools miss functional bugs. And in-house human QA teams can’t scale with today’s release cycles.

CTOs, VPs, Directors of Eng, and QA leads at fast-growing companies are asking:

> Why does our test suite say green when our users say broken?

**🛠️ Why We Built This: From frustrated mobile engineers to reinventing QA**

We’ve been mobile engineers at Google who shipped products like Android XR, Quick Share, Stadia, and foldable phones. We’ve seen firsthand how slow, flaky QA can derail a great product. We built QualGent so teams can catch real bugs faster, ship with confidence, and stop wasting time maintaining fragile tests.

We're grateful to be part of the YC community and excited to bring modern AI to a painful, expensive problem that slows down almost every mobile team we’ve met.

**⚙️ The Solution: QualGent - Your AI QA Copilot**

QualGent uses computer-use LLM agents and vision models to mimic a real human tester:

1. You describe a test in natural language (“Sign up, go to settings, change theme”)
2. Our AI agent runs that test on real iOS and Android devices in the cloud
3. It taps, swipes, scrolls, types, speaks, listens - just like a human
4. And gives you video, logs, and test reports for every step

No more rigid scripting. No more emulator-only limits. No more test maintenance hell.

Our AI agent self-heals, handles dynamic pop-up content, navigates unexpected UI changes, and catches bugs like a pro.

**🧠 Our Vision: Complete the AI coding-testing loop to ship quality products 100x faster**

Our vision is to close the loop on software creation. As AI enables engineers to code 100x faster, QualGent eliminates the next bottleneck—software verification—unlocking truly scalable, end-to-end product-driven software development.

**📢 Try it and Help Us Spread the Word: Let’s reimagine mobile QA together**

1. Book a demo with us and see QualGent in action on your app!
2. Know someone leading mobile engineering? We’d love a warm intro.

We rethought what QA could be with AI, you’ll want to test this. Let’s make releasing great mobile apps a joy again.
